journalEntry.title: Journal Entry
journalEntry.description: A private journal entry written by the authenticated user with AI mood tracking and reflection insights.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the entry author.

content.description: Full markdown or text body of the journal entry.

mood.description: The user's self-selected or inferred primary emotional state.

moodScore.description: Numeric mood valence score on a scale from 1 (very low) to 10 (exceptionally positive).

tags.description: Optional categorizing tags for the journal entry.

reflectionInsight.description: AI-generated philosophical reflection and empathetic perspective.

sentimentAnalysis.description: Brief breakdown of emotional tones identified by Gemini.

keyThemes.description: Key conceptual themes identified in the entry.

emotionalTriggers.description: Specific emotional triggers or stressors identified by Gemini in the entry.

copingStrategies.description: Personalized evidence-based coping strategies tailored to the entry.

coverImageUrl.description: Unique mood-inspired cover image data URL or web URL generated for this entry.

coverImagePrompt.description: The artistic visual prompt used to generate the cover image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was last modified.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Subcollection of journal entries belonging strictly to the user matching {userId}.
